title: Singil Church Baseball Mission Website
role: End-to-end planning, design, publishing, frontend, and record-pipeline development
introduction: The official Nuxt 3 website for managing the Singil Church Baseball Mission's game records and operational content. It integrates about, records, games, roster, MVP, videos, news, and contact content, with an automated GameOne HTML-to-JSON pipeline that enables efficient operation without a separate backend.
myWorks: Designed IA for about/leaders/history, team gallery, full/yearly/monthly/group records, monthly/weekly MVP, roster, games, YouTube, news, and contact
Built `parse-game-html`, `build-records`, and `update-records` scripts that parse GameOne HTML with cheerio into per-game and summary JSON
Implemented A-group (Davids) / D-group auto classification, playerId-based stat aggregation, AG Grid record tables, and game-detail MVP/highlight sections
Handled GitHub Pages base paths via `useBasePath`/`fetchJson()` and documented post-game ops in `GAME_RECORD_UPDATE_HANDOFF.md`
In June: dark/light themes, home layout for recent games and video links, leader card component with dynamic image paths, favicon, and SCSS consolidation
Organized static deployment with GitHub Actions, `npm run deploy`, sitemap generation, JSON-LD, and dynamic SEO meta for games and news
achievements: Delivered the core capabilities required for operation, including IA, records, statistics, roster, media, and deployment
Established an operator-friendly flow: drop GameOne HTML and run `npm run update` once to rebuild game and summary records
Encoded baseball-domain rules—excluding opponent stats and matching names via `players.json`—in parsing scripts and the README
points: Match record updates without a separate server
Match, player, video, and MVP content
GitHub Pages deployment, accessibility, and themes
